items.question: Do enemies bow at the practitioner's feet when ghee-anointed items are used?
premises: Ghee-anointed items are used in rite.
items.inference: The rite causes enemies to submit.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical gender and number of sarpiṣājyāplutābhiḥ remain uncertain.
Whether te refers to enemies or items remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Anointed with ghee, they indeed bow at the feet.
